t: The Sylvania RefLed Superia GU5.3 MR16 LED light bulb provides premium professional-grade illumination, engineered to replicate the familiar look and feel of traditional halogen MR16 lamps. This advanced LED lamp delivers 621 lumens of bright light from a low 6.1W power consumption, ensuring energy efficiency for property managers and electricians. With an impressive lifespan of up to 25,000 hours and enduring 100,000 switching cycles, it offers exceptional longevity. Its dimmable capability and compatibility with both magnetic and electronic transformers make it a versatile choice for various installations, from kitchens and bathrooms to retail displays and corridors.
